sloka: अथोवाच प्रहस्यैतान् रावणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।महोदरमहापार्श्वौ विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसम् ।। ६.९६.९ ।।
transliteration: athovāca prahasyaitān rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ।mahodaramahāpārśvau virūpākṣaṁ ca rākṣasam ।। 6.96.9 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana who was deluded with anger, laughing aloud spoke to Mahodara, Mahaparsva and Virupaksha.
